title: QMU.io
summary: A privacy-first, browser-based psychometric profiling application that builds a psychological profile from natural conversation using local WebGPU AI models. A research planning document in the repo (research/Fine-Tuned-Psychometrics.md) proposes using SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer and evaluate_quality to generate and validate synthetic psychometric training data.
evidence: research/Fine-Tuned-Psychometrics.md:1703-1816 shows 'from sdv.single_table import GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer' and 'from sdv.evaluation.single_table import run_diagnostic, evaluate_quality' as example code in a markdown research doc
needs: Confirm whether the SDV code in the research markdown was ever executed in the (TypeScript) codebase, or remains purely a documented proposal.
